style.css.note: The theme header. `Template: unysonplus-theme` makes it a child of the Unyson+ theme.

functions.php.note: Empty on purpose: the parent theme loads inc/includes/ automatically. Read the warning about inc/ file names.

inc/includes/headless-books-types.php.note: Registers the Book post type and Genre taxonomy with show_in_rest, so they appear in the API.

inc/includes/headless-books-rest.php.note: Adds the field values to each book's REST response, and resolves the cover image to a URL, size and alt text.

framework-customizations/theme/options/p.note: Unyson+ loads this file for the Book edit screen. Each option id is the key the value is saved under.

README.md.note: What each file does, and how to install the theme.
